messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "tell your doctor if you have any of them so your dose can be checked"
set: ["tell your doctor if you have any of them so your dose can be checked", "tell your doctor if you have diabetes", "tell your doctor if you have phenylketonuria", "tell your doctor if you have any changes in sexual function", "tell your doctor if you have phenylketonuria (PKU)", "tell your doctor if you have a planned surgery", "tell your doctor if you have a thyroid disorder", "tell your doctor if you have type 2 diabetes", "tell your doctor if you have ever had anemia", "tell your doctor if you have ever had diabetes", "tell your doctor if you have ever had thyroiditis", "tell your doctor if you also use", "tell your doctor if you are pregnant", "tell your doctor if you have ever had heart problems", "tell your doctor if you have alcoholism or drug addiction", "tell your doctor if you have a muscle weakness condition"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
